_note: Drives scripts/testability-report.js (HTML view of docs/testability/missing-resource-ids.md). `features` maps register rows to a product + feature: `section` is a regex tested against the text after '## Open — ' and `screen` a regex tested against the row's Screen cell; first match wins, an omitted regex matches anything. Rows no feature matches are listed under an 'Unmapped' group (the run prints a warning) — give them a home here. Product `color` is optional ({ light, dark } hex); a palette colour is used when it is missing. Inline text supports `code` and **bold**.
